PERKINS, England
Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, to be performed every 150 operation hour as 
 indicated by H150 in the above title block.
Technical specification

The first 
 draft is initiated by eng. Hatem 
 Esmat Aly, 
 reviewed by eng. Ahmed Abdel Rahman: maintenance manager, 
 tested by eng. Sameh 
 Ibrahem Kamal, 
 revised by eng.
Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection 
 & quality control general director & 
MPIS coordinator, accepted by general 
 manager eng. Mahmoud Al-Naqeeb, and approved by eng. 
 Tarek Yousef; head sector of 
 Ayon Mousa PS.

This document accepted by 
eng. 
Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection and quality control general director & 
MPIS coordinator, 
and certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman: EDEPC 
planning & financial prediction head sector and supervisor of inspection & 
quality control's head sector.
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued and the maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

items:
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety 
 shoes, hearing protection, gloves, ... 
 etc.
Isolate the circuit breaker for the diesel engine.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning articles (fluid, rags. etc)
Feeler gauge, suitable lifting device
Multimeter, and common sets keys

Test equipment level 
 "dip sticks"

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Before 
 Isolated the Diesel Engine Mechanically and Electrically

Operate the engine and 
 check the following steps and reads all the available record values in the MRDS 
 table 1

Check the lubricating oil level in the tank. In between 
 up to the top mark on the dip-stick
Check the fuel level in the fuel tank

Check the exhaust gas temperature 800
 oC 20 oC

Check the exhaust gases color 
 should be Colorless

Check the engine oil temperature 80
 oC : 90 oC

Check any leakage from the piping 
 connections to the diesel engine or its accessories (water, lube oil, fuel, 
 and air)

Check (by listening) the regular operation 
 of the engine and whether there is no abnormal sounds or knocks

Check the engine water temperature 65
 oC : 85 oC

Check the operation of suction and exhaust 
 valves, check the condition of the valve springs

Check (by touch) the crankshaft and 
 cam-shaft bearings temperature rise on the case covers of the cylinder 
 blocks, at the points where the bearings are located

Check the starting valves for tightness by 
 touching the starting air pipes heating on cylinder heads
